description: Coding agent (Claude Code / Aider style) driving the proxy. Large tool-heavy contexts, short-to-medium outputs, many back-to-back turns with almost no think time.
assumptions: A session is one task: 5-60 model calls, median 15.
Each call resends a large context: ~12k tokens median (repo files, tool output), up to ~60k.
Outputs are tool calls or short edits: ~200 tokens median.
Think time is tool execution: ~1.5 s median, up to ~15 s.
Streams ~70% of calls; retries are left to the proxy; abandons after 120 s.
